whatIs: shadcn/ui isn't a library you install as a dependency: it's a collection of accessible, well-crafted components whose code is copied into your project for you to adapt. Besides the component catalog, it offers blocks, charts and a tool for creating your own base.
It's a good fit when you want to build your own design system on a solid foundation, controlling the code of each piece.
uses: Building a dashboard with tables, forms and charts using the blocks and charts.
Creating a company's design system starting from accessible components that you modify as you like.
Adding individual components, such as a dialog or a select, to an existing project.
caveats: The code lives in your repository, so you apply updates and fixes by hand.
It's oriented to React and Tailwind CSS; outside that ecosystem you'll have to look for adaptations.
It requires a bit of initial setup before you add the first component.
pricingNote: Open source under the MIT license.
idealFor: Teams that want to own and customize the code of their components.
